snippet.title: Psycutlery - from the dev of "Psycho Waluigi" - now on Steam!  FREE!
snippet.description:
Over a decade in development, from Luke Tarlowe (AKA Thunder Dragon) -
!!- GET IT HERE! -!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3577630/Psycutlery/

(plays great on Steam Deck!)

If you like this game, PLEASE tell your friends and leave a positive review on Steam.  Any bit of visibility counts in helping this game find its audience!

This game features soundtrack contributions by DJ Yoshiman - you can purchase his songs here:
https://djyoshiman.bandcamp.com/album/psycutlery

Interested in chatting with the developer and other players?  We have a Discord server:
https://discord.gg/NS2jyKqR7H

We also post on Bluesky, sometimes
https://bsky.app/profile/eyesineverything.bsky.social
